code:
use default

let number_words = MAP()

let units = [
    "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine",
    "ten", "eleven", "twelve", "thirteen", "fourteen", "fifteen", "sixteen",
    "seventeen", "eighteen", "nineteen"
]

let tens = ["twenty", "thirty", "forty", "fifty", "sixty", "seventy",
            "eighty", "ninety"]

for (position, word) in units |> index() do
    number_words.add(word, position + 1)
od

for (position, word) in tens |> index() do
    number_words.add(word, (position + 2) * 10)
od

number_words.add("single", 1)
number_words.add("a", 0)
number_words.add("and", 0)

let punctuation_names = MAP()

punctuation_names.add("comma", ',')
punctuation_names.add("apostrophe", '\'')
punctuation_names.add("hyphen", '-')

count_of[K](counts: MAP[K, int], key: K) -> int =>
    if counts.contains_key(key) then counts[key] else 0 fi

actual_counts(sentence: string, with_punctuation: bool) -> MAP[char, int] is
    let counts = MAP()

    for character in sentence.to_lower() do
        let counted =
            char.is_letter(character) \/
            (with_punctuation /\ ",'-!".contains(character))

        if counted then
            counts[character] = count_of(counts, character) + 1
        fi
    od

    return counts
si

claimed_item(word: string) -> char? is
    let bare = word.trim_end([',', '.', ':'])

    if bare =~ "!" then
        return '!'
    fi

    let stem = if bare.ends_with("'s") then bare[0..<2]
               elif bare.ends_with("s") then bare[0..<1]
               else bare fi

    if punctuation_names.contains_key(stem) then
        return punctuation_names[stem]
    elif stem.length == 1 /\ char.is_letter(stem[0]) then
        return stem[0]
    fi

    return null
si

claimed_counts(sentence: string) -> MAP[char, int] is
    let claims = MAP()
    let pending mut = 0

    for word in sentence.to_lower().replace("-", " ").split([' ']) do
        let bare = word.trim_end([',', '.', ':'])

        if number_words.contains_key(bare) then
            pending = pending + number_words[bare]
        elif let item = claimed_item(word) /\ pending > 0 then
            claims[item] = pending
            pending = 0
        else
            pending = 0
        fi
    od

    return claims
si

is_autogram(sentence: string, with_punctuation: bool) -> bool is
    let actual = actual_counts(sentence, with_punctuation)
    let claimed = claimed_counts(sentence)

    return actual.count == claimed.count /\
        actual |> all((character, count) =>
            count_of(claimed, character) == count)
